title: Mean first escape times of Brownian motion on asymptotically hyperbolic and gas giant metric surfaces
summary: This paper deals with the mean first escape time of Brownian motion on asymptotically hyperbolic and gas giant surfaces. We show that for a boundary defining function $ρ$, the mean first escape time $u_ε(x)$ from the truncated Riemannian surface with an asymptotically hyperbolic metric $(M_ε,\bar{g}/ρ^2) = (\{x\in M:ρ(x)\geq ε\},\bar{g}/ρ^2) \subset (M,\bar{g}/ρ^2)$ satisfies the asymptotic expansion $u_ε(x) = -\log ε+ \mathcal{O}(1)$ as $ε\to 0 $.
